item.title: What is the difference between phone airplane mode and turning off?
item.description: Confused about whether to use airplane mode or power off your phone? Airplane mode disables wireless connections while keeping your device operational for offline tasks, alarms, and apps. Turning off completely shuts down everything, using virtually no battery but requiring a full restart. The choice impacts battery life, alarm functionality, and accessibility.
